_readme: A rule is tool(pattern), or a bare tool name to cover every call to it.
Order of judgement: deny > confirm > ask > allow > default_action.
deny is final. confirm always asks and can never be answered with
'always' - the approval is good for that one call only.
Path patterns are globs where * stops at / and ** does not.
Command patterns are globs where * matches anything, including /.
Compound commands are split on && || ; | & and each part is judged alone.
Layers only ever ADD rules: built-in defaults, then this file, then
read for its restrictions only until you vouch for it once.
